scope: Additional safe classroom experiment concepts only.

experiments.title: Salt versus water
experiments.focus: Show the difference between a solid solute and a liquid solvent.
student_observations: The salt starts as a solid.
The water acts as the solvent.
A solution forms when the solid disappears into the liquid.
experiments.teacher_note: Use this as a basic solution model.

experiments.title: Ethanol and water mix
experiments.focus: Compare two clear liquids and how they mix in the classroom model.
student_observations: The mixture stays uniform in the model.
Some liquids mix easily with water.
experiments.teacher_note: A simple way to introduce miscibility.

experiments.title: Vinegar and salt
experiments.focus: Compare the behavior of a weak acid solution and a neutral salt in water.
student_observations: The salt dissolves while the vinegar remains a liquid.
Different substances can coexist in the same beaker.
experiments.teacher_note: This is a classification example, not a lab recipe.

experiments.title: Solution loopback
experiments.focus: Review the idea that not all clear liquids behave the same way.
student_observations: Some liquids mix with each other easily.
Physical properties help tell substances apart.
experiments.teacher_note: Good wrap-up activity for mixture and solution lessons.
